definitions.gloss: desperate, strenuous, with all one's might
definitions.explanation: Putting maximum effort into something; trying one's hardest.

examples.japanese: {懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}っている→養う：04478_yashinau⟧。
examples.english: I work hard to support my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧{懸命|けんめい}⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: He studied with all his might.

examples.japanese: {懸命|けんめい}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}った→実る：00282_minoru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいた→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。

examples.english: I shouted with all my might to cheer for the team.

notes:
USAGE:
{懸命|けんめい} on its own is somewhat written ({懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧, {懸命|けんめい}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧). In speech it appears mostly inside ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧, the everyday way to say "as hard as one can".

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧ was originally {一所懸命|いっしょけんめい}: a samurai staking his life on one piece of land.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work desperately hard)
- {懸命|けんめい}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (strenuous efforts)
- {懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧ (to appeal desperately)
- {懸命|けんめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧ (an all-out search)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧ - desperate, frantic; stresses that something must not fail, often with a sense of panic.
- ⟦{熱心|ねっしん}→熱心：01207_nesshin⟧ - eager, keen; about interest and enthusiasm rather than strain.
